answer.why: Both AMG and Virtus operate as multi-boutique asset management platforms that partner with independent investment managers to deliver investment strategies to institutional and individual investors. AMG [T:P1.2, T:P1.4, T:P1.10] holds stakes in independent boutique firms and provides distribution/strategic support; Virtus [C:P1.3, C:P2.5, C:P2.8, C:P2.10] uses a multi-manager, multi-strategy model through affiliated boutique managers. Both serve the same customer base—institutional investors, financial advisors/intermediaries, and individual investors [T:P1.9, T:P1.10, C:P1.3, C:P1.5, C:P2.4]—and both earn AUM-based fees. The structural nuance (AMG invests in firms vs. Virtus directly sponsors managers as affiliates) is a secondary difference within the same multi-boutique asset management industry, not a different business model. These companies are regularly benchmarked against each other in the asset management sector.

T:P1.2.text: Affiliated Managers Group (AMG) is a global asset management company that partners with outstanding alpha-generating independent firms.

T:P1.3.text: Independent investment firms have fundamental competitive advantages in generating differentiated returns.

T:P1.4.text: We invest in these firms through partnerships that magnify their success, as they bring their unique return streams to investors worldwide.

T:P1.5.text: We offer a unique approach to partnership.

T:P1.6.text: We provide the advantages of a long-term strategic partnership as we invest capital and resources in and alongside our partner firms while preserving their autonomy and independence. We adapt our solutions to our Affiliates’ unique strategic opportunities to create further success together.

T:P1.7.text: Committed to evolving and growing together.

T:P1.8.text: We offer powerful strategic capabilities centered around your firm’s distinct opportunities.

T:P1.9.text: We offer financial advisors and their clients access to investor-led independent managers with differentiated investment solutions.

T:P1.10.text: AMG’s global institutional distribution platform operates in key markets around the world, extending the reach of Affiliates’ business development efforts.

T:P1.11.text: Our Affiliates manage client assets across a diverse range of secular growth areas and are focused on creating value for their clients.

T:P1.12.text: Magnifying the success of independent firms around the world.

T:P2.2.text: Learn our history, and how we generate superior growth through partnerships with outstanding investment firms around the world.

T:P2.3.text: This website is designed for display in modern browsers. Your browser is not currently supported. Please use the latest version of Chrome, Opera, Firefox, Safari or Edge.

T:P2.4.text: AMG is a strategic partner to, and long-term investor in, leading independent investment firms globally.

T:P2.5.text: We provide the advantages of partnership to magnify our Affiliates’ success, while preserving their autonomy and independence. With AMG, Affiliates are able to expand their reach, diversify their business, and achieve further success.

T:P2.6.text: When Affiliates choose AMG as a partner, they are choosing independence. Not only do our partners value their autonomy, their clients also recognize that an independent firm’s entrepreneurial and investment-centric culture is instrumental to generating differentiated long-term returns.

T:P2.7.text: Having operated our distinct partnership model for 30 years, our entrepreneurial spirit, ownership mindset, and focus on excellence are deeply rooted.

T:P2.8.text: We generate long-term value by investing in a diverse array of high-quality independent partner-owned firms, through a proven partnership approach, and allocating resources across AMG’s unique opportunity set to the areas of highest growth and return.

T:P2.9.text: Diversified asset base and partnership structure enhance business stability and flexibility to invest for growth

T:P2.10.text: Our Affiliates maintain independence and autonomy as well as significant direct equity ownership in their individual firms.

T:P2.11.text: Through an AMG partnership, Affiliates’ interests stay aligned with their clients’ interests, and Affiliate management teams have the continued opportunity to participate directly in their firms’ long-term growth and success.

T:P2.12.text: We provide strategic and business development capabilities to our Affiliates to enhance their desired evolution toward new opportunities, and their next phase of success.

C:P1.3.text: Virtus Investment Partners is a distinctive partnership of boutique investment managers, singularly committed to the long-term success of individual and institutional investors.

C:P1.5.text: Individual Investor Financial Professional Institutional Investor or Consultant International Investor Non-U.S. Investor (UCITS & QIAIFs)

C:P2.2.text: A distinctive company with a multi-manager, multi-strategy model

C:P2.3.text: A Message from George R. Aylward President and Chief Executive Officer

C:P2.4.text: Welcome to Virtus Investment Partners, a company dedicated to being a distinctive and trusted provider of asset management solutions for individual and institutional investors.

C:P2.5.text: Our goal is to offer clients high-quality investment strategies that have generated compelling performance and meet multiple financial needs. To accomplish this, we employ a multi-manager, multi-strategy approach that delivers a broad array of solutions.

C:P2.6.text: Each of our investment partners has a distinct investment philosophy and style, with talent and discipline that have been tested through market cycles and validated by performance over time. Importantly, they all share an unwavering commitment to investor success.

C:P2.7.text: We hope you will consider joining us as a client.

C:P2.8.text: Our multi-manager, multi-strategy approach gives clients access to distinctive investment strategies from independent managers.

C:P2.9.text: We have the flexibility, agility, and responsiveness of a boutique asset management firm with the product breadth, distribution reach, and resources of larger firms.

C:P2.10.text: Our multi-boutique model is based on the fundamental belief that investment professionals who operate in an environment that allows for the appropriate focus and culture can generate sustainable, superior returns for our clients.

C:P3.1.text: AlphaSimplex Group, LLC | Virtus Investment Partners

C:P3.2.text: AlphaSimplex is a systematic alternatives manager focused on delivering quantitative investment strategies that are attuned to changing market dynamics.

C:P3.4.text: AlphaSimplex strives to help investors meet their long-term goals in ever-evolving markets by analyzing market behavior and risk. Our investment philosophy is based on the Adaptive Markets Hypothesis, an innovative theory of market behavior.

C:P3.6.text: Virtus AlphaSimplex Managed Futures Strategy Fund

C:P3.7.text: Virtus GF AlphaSimplex Managed Futures Fund

C:P3.10.text: Chief Investment Officer, Portfolio Manager Industry Start Date: 2007

C:P3.11.text: Alexander Healy is the chief investment officer and a portfolio manager at AlphaSimplex, an affiliated manager of Virtus Investment Partners. Dr. Healy is responsible for the day-to-day supervision of the research team and the implementation of the firm’s investment strategies. He is the chair of the firm’s investment committee and a member of the operating and risk committees. Additionally, he serves as a co-portfolio manager of certain funds.

C:P3.12.text: Dr. Healy joined AlphaSimplex and held the roles of senior research scientist, director of strategic research, and deputy chief investment officer. He has developed various key elements of AlphaSimplex’s investment platform, including non-parametric investment models, volatility management overlays, and dynamic approaches to portfolio construction.
